summary: GRASP learns context-dependent chemical properties beyond input tokens, but some features are trivial (already in token). Key findings: aromaticity detection improves at layer 8 (benzene vs cyclohexane distinction), ring size learned via message passing (not in token), functional groups require different context depths.

claims.claim: GRASP distinguishes aromatic from non-aromatic rings beyond simple 'in-ring' boolean
claims.test: SMARTS: [c] (aromatic C) vs [C] (aliphatic C in ring)
claims.prediction: At layer 8+, atoms in benzene should have higher aromaticity score than cyclohexane

claims.claim: Hybridization is trivial - already encoded in input token
claims.test: Check if tok_element='C' and tok_degree matches expected hybridization (sp2 vs sp3)
claims.prediction: No improvement with layers - feature is local

claims.claim: Ring size is NOT in input token but learned via message passing
claims.test: SMARTS: [C] in 3-membered ring vs [C] in 6-membered ring
claims.prediction: Atoms in small rings should have lower min_ring_size score than large rings

claims.claim: Carbonyl carbon detection is mostly local (layer 1)
claims.prediction: Carbonyl C distinguished within 1 hop (direct bond to O)

claims.claim: Ester functional group requires broader context than amide
claims.evidence: fg_ester: token=0.868 AUC, grasp_best(layer6)=0.997; fg_amide: token=0.972 AUC, grasp_best(layer4)=1.0
claims.prediction: Ester needs more hops to distinguish O-C=O from N-C=O

claims.claim: Michael acceptor detection requires context beyond immediate neighbors
claims.prediction: Needs 3-4 hops to capture conjugation pattern

claims.claim: Heteroatom neighbor detection shows electronic effect learning
claims.evidence: has_O_neighbor: token=0.876 AUC, grasp_best(layer4)=1.0, gap=0.124; has_N_neighbor: token=0.791 AUC, grasp_best(layer4)=1.0, gap=0.209
claims.prediction: Inductive/resonance effects learned through message passing

claims.test: Check if carboxylic acid atoms exist in training set
claims.prediction: Either no such atoms or probe implementation issue
Triple bond to N is local feature

claims.claim: Aromatic nitrogen detection improves slightly with context
claims.test: SMARTS: [n] in aromatic ring (pyridine) vs aliphatic N
claims.prediction: Pyridine N distinguished from pyrrole N with context

trivial_explanations: hybridization is trivial because input token includes degree+H count which determines sp2/sp3
fg_nitrile is trivial because C≡N triple bond is local structural feature
tok_element and tok_in_ring baselines are expected to be near-perfect (they ARE the features)
